title: Request a proposal, review or assessment | Aquemi
meta: Sizing proposal, route assessment, URS, feedwater or C&Q review, or system assessment. An engineer replies in [proposal response time, working days].
headline: Tell us what you need sized, reviewed or assessed. An engineer answers in writing.
lead: Choose a review of your user requirement specification (URS) or feed water, a route assessment or a sizing proposal. The form asks only what that request needs. Nothing here commits you to buy.

secondary_cta.label: System down or out of specification? Request service

blocks.h: What happens after you send it

items.d: A process engineer replies by name within [proposal response time, working days]. No sales call unless you ask.
Yours or ours, returned signed within [NDA turnaround, working days].
About [scoping call length, minutes], for proposals and assessments. Reviews often need none.
Signed by the engineer who wrote it. If we are not the right supplier, we say so.
Fixed scope and price, documentation list and schedule, valid for [proposal validity, days].

items.q: We do not have a URS yet. Is it too early?
items.a: No. Choose a water scope review or a route assessment. We return the grades, systems and qualification scope your URS should state, and you write it on that basis.

items.q: Does a review commit us to buying from you?
items.a: No. A review or assessment is a written answer you keep. [Confirm reviews carry no obligation.] [Which reviews are free, which charged.] We quote any charge before work starts.

items.q: Our system was built by another supplier. Which form do we use?
items.a: For an upgrade, more capacity or a full assessment, this one: choose "Assessment of an existing system, any make". For a fault, maintenance or calibration, use the service request form: it takes systems from other builders with the make and model, no Aquemi serial number needed. We service [makes and equipment types serviced].

items.q: We are a consulting or EPCM engineer writing a specification for a client. Can we ask?
items.a: Yes. Choose the document review or the route assessment and say who the end user is, if you can. We answer the specification question and do not contact your client.

items.q: We have a tender package with our own forms. Can you bid to it?
items.a: Upload the package and the closing date and choose "Sizing and budget proposal for a new system". We reply within [proposal response time, working days] to confirm whether we will bid, with any clarification questions, before the deadline.

items.q: Will you sign our NDA before we share drawings?
items.a: Yes. Choose "Send our NDA first, then talk" in step 3, or attach your NDA. We return it signed within [NDA turnaround, working days].
